summary.disclaimer: AI heuristic indicators, not validated UX metrics.

findings.title: Severe Low-Contrast Gray-on-Gray Notice Text
findings.problem: Notice banner uses light gray text (#CBD5E1) on an off-white background (#F8FAFC), yielding an unacceptable 1.8:1 contrast ratio.
findings.impact: Users with low vision or working in bright ambient lighting cannot read system synchronization alerts, risking data loss.
findings.solution: Darken the text to #334155 (6.2:1 contrast) and add an info icon indicator.
findings.evidence: Measured contrast about 2.3:1 (needs 4.5:1), sampled from screenshot

findings.title: Primary 'Submit Order' CTA Styled Like Inactive Secondary Button
findings.problem: The primary 'Submit Order' button is styled with a faded gray background (#E2E8F0) and dull gray text (#64748B), making it visually indistinguishable from disabled or secondary controls.
findings.impact: Users hesitate at checkout/submission, generating drop-offs and redundant clicks.
findings.solution: Style with solid brand primary color (#6D4AFF), white bold text, and a distinct hover elevation.
findings.evidence: Button fill #E2E8F0 has less than 5% luminance contrast compared to adjacent neutral surfaces.

findings.title: Tiny 22px Action Buttons Violate Touch/Click Target Minimums
findings.problem: Header action buttons measure only 22x22px with no visible text labels or tooltips.
findings.impact: Causes frequent mis-clicks, frustration, and accidental destructive actions like deletion.
findings.solution: Expand clickable padding to at least 44x44px and provide accessible labels or tooltips.
findings.evidence: Button bounding box measures 22x22px, far below the recommended 44x44px minimum target area.

findings.title: Unhelpful 'Invalid' Error Banner Without Field Guidance
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #9 Help Users Recognize, Diagnose, and Recover from Errors
findings.problem: A generic red banner states 'Invalid.' without identifying which input failed or how to correct it.
findings.impact: Users are blocked from completing dispatch orders because they cannot diagnose formatting errors.
findings.solution: Replace with inline validation under the specific input (e.g., 'Internal Ledger Key must follow format XX-X-XXX-XX').
findings.evidence: Single word banner 'Invalid.' rendered without inline field associations.

findings.title: Cryptic 9-Item Flat Navigation With 3-Letter Abbreviations
findings.problem: Top navigation bar lists 9 cryptic three-letter abbreviations ('Sys', 'Opr', 'Lst', 'Rec'...) with no active indicator.
findings.impact: Steep learning curve; new users cannot navigate the system without external documentation.
findings.solution: Use human-readable labels ('System', 'Operations', 'Inventory List') and highlight the active view.
findings.evidence: 9 adjacent items formatted as truncated 3-letter acronyms without icons or explanatory tooltips.

findings.title: Dense Unstructured Wall of Text Reduces Scannability
findings.problem: Instructions are presented as a 4-line uninterrupted block of dense text without subheadings or bullets.
findings.impact: Operators overlook critical instructions regarding barcode verification and pallet weight calibrations.
findings.solution: Format the operational instructions into 3 structured bullet points with bold keywords.
findings.evidence: Body paragraph spans over 380 characters without typographical hierarchy or itemized breaks.

findings.title: Fixed-Width Table Induces Horizontal Scrolling on Smaller Viewports
findings.problem: The inventory batch table is configured with a fixed width, causing horizontal layout overflow.
findings.impact: On laptops and tablet screens, key columns like status and routing gateways are hidden off-screen.
findings.solution: Implement a responsive scroll wrapper with sticky headers or collapsible card views on narrow screens.
findings.evidence: Table container width extends beyond viewport boundaries on viewports under 1200px.

fix_prompt:
You are improving the UI/UX of this existing application. Apply the following prioritized fixes without breaking any existing functionality, layout flow, or business logic.

Context for changes:
- Target User Persona: Inventory Warehouse Specialist
- User Goal: Dispatch shipment and reconcile stock

PRIORITIZED FIXES:
1. [CRITICAL] Severe Low-Contrast Gray-on-Gray Notice Text
   - Problem: Notice banner uses light gray text (#CBD5E1) on an off-white background (#F8FAFC), yielding an unacceptable 1.8:1 contrast ratio.
   - Fix: Darken the text to #334155 (6.2:1 contrast) and add an info icon indicator.
   - Target Area: approx. top left (x: 4%, y: 19%)
   - Heuristic / Guideline: WCAG 2.1 AA 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)

2. [HIGH] Primary 'Submit Order' CTA Styled Like Inactive Secondary Button
   - Problem: The primary 'Submit Order' button is styled with a faded gray background (#E2E8F0) and dull gray text (#64748B), making it visually indistinguishable from disabled or secondary controls.
   - Fix: Style with solid brand primary color (#6D4AFF), white bold text, and a distinct hover elevation.
   - Target Area: approx. bottom right (x: 68%, y: 72%)
   - Heuristic / Guideline: Nielsen #4 Consistency and Standards

3. [HIGH] Tiny 22px Action Buttons Violate Touch/Click Target Minimums
   - Problem: Header action buttons measure only 22x22px with no visible text labels or tooltips.
   - Fix: Expand clickable padding to at least 44x44px and provide accessible labels or tooltips.
   - Target Area: approx. top right (x: 86%, y: 10%)
   - Heuristic / Guideline: WCAG 2.1 AAA 2.5.5 Target Size

4. [HIGH] Unhelpful 'Invalid' Error Banner Without Field Guidance
   - Problem: A generic red banner states 'Invalid.' without identifying which input failed or how to correct it.
   - Fix: Replace with inline validation under the specific input (e.g., 'Internal Ledger Key must follow format XX-X-XXX-XX').
   - Target Area: approx. top right (x: 68%, y: 23%)
   - Heuristic / Guideline: Nielsen #9 Help Users Recognize, Diagnose, and Recover from Errors

5. [MEDIUM] Cryptic 9-Item Flat Navigation With 3-Letter Abbreviations
   - Problem: Top navigation bar lists 9 cryptic three-letter abbreviations ('Sys', 'Opr', 'Lst', 'Rec'...) with no active indicator.
   - Fix: Use human-readable labels ('System', 'Operations', 'Inventory List') and highlight the active view.
   - Target Area: approx. top left (x: 2%, y: 2%)
   - Heuristic / Guideline: Nielsen #6 Recognition Rather Than Recall

GUIDELINES FOR THE FIXES:
- Maintain WCAG AA compliance (ensure text contrast is at least 4.5:1 for body and 3:1 for large headers).
- Ensure interactive touch/click targets are at least 44x44px.
- Use consistent typography hierarchy, spacing scale, and clear state styling (hover/focus/disabled/active).
- Keep the existing technology stack and component architecture intact.
- Once finished, summarize the exact code modifications made.
